note: GM 2026-10-25: "Leave the social rules as optional, but I really was looking for creature dispositions when encountered. A social creature is loosely defined as INT 4+"; "Those determinations can signify if a creature is neutral or hostile according to intelligence and faction". The SRD's own default (Indifferent) stays the rule unless the GM switches this pack on for a campaign.

aberration.helps: Offering lost lore or forbidden historical knowledge.
aberration.hurts: Invoking the names of modern gods or planar entities.

beast.helps: Offering fresh food; moving slowly with weapons sheathed.
beast.hurts: Cornering the beast or making sudden, deafening noises.

celestial.helps: Honesty, acts of self-sacrifice, or defending innocents.
celestial.hurts: Attempting to lie (Deception) or threatening violence.

construct.helps: Providing specific maintenance commands or repair keys.
construct.hurts: Damaging its guarded property or structures.

dragon.helps: Flattery, tribute offerings, or acknowledging their hierarchy.
dragon.hurts: Touching their hoard or showing blatant disrespect.

elemental.helps: Presenting pure elemental fuel (e.g., source of fire or rare minerals).
elemental.hurts: Using spells that control, bind, or banish elementals.

fey.helps: Engaging in playful riddles, gift-giving, or clever wit.
fey.hurts: Breaking a sworn promise, contract, or formal oath.

fiend.helps: Offering written contracts, collateral, or souls.
fiend.hurts: Appealing to their morality, mercy, or altruism.

giant.helps: Demonstrating significant physical strength or tactical military logic.
giant.hurts: Insulting their lineage, craft, or social standing.

humanoid.helps: Aligning with their faction's goals or trading currency/goods.
humanoid.hurts: Threatening their family, home territory, or leadership.

monstrosity.helps: Throwing specialized food/minerals or giving them wide berths.
monstrosity.hurts: Blocking their clear path to prey or active hunting grounds.

ooze.helps: Luring it away with massive amounts of organic waste/acidic matter.
ooze.hurts: Damaging it with elements it naturally absorbs.

plant.helps: Presenting specialized fertilizers or altering light/water sources.
plant.hurts: Introducing open fire, defoliants, or clear-cutting tools.

undead.helps: Displaying symbols of dark authority or necromantic control.
undead.hurts: Brandishing holy symbols, radiant magic, or life energy.

instinct.text: A creature of Intelligence 3 or lower is not a social creature: it goes by instinct. A predator (it bites, claws, stings, constricts or engulfs) is Hostile; any other is Indifferent. Mindless Constructs, Oozes, Plants and Undead keep their type's attitude (Hostile). It can't be talked into anything; a Beast or Monstrosity can be coaxed with Wisdom (Animal Handling).

broken-ring.name: The Broken Ring
broken-ring.text: A ruthless syndicate of highwaymen, deserters, and opportunists. Hostile: they assume any armed group entering their territory is either a rival crew or a bounty hunting squad.
broken-ring.note: The supplement's Thugs are the SRD 5.2.1 Tough; its Acolytes the Priest Acolyte; its Cult Fanatics the Cultist Fanatic.

obsidian-scribes.name: The Obsidian Scribes
obsidian-scribes.text: A secretive cabal of historians and mages. Indifferent: they view adventurers as loud, clumsy variables who disrupt delicate research sites.

pale-flame.name: The Keepers of the Pale Flame
pale-flame.text: A doomsday sect. Hostile: outsiders are viewed as fuel for their sacrificial pyres or direct threats to their grand prophecy.
